scripts.test:e2e: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('e2e-ui/config.json', JSON.stringify({retention:7,retentionMode:'months',paths:[],sqlite:[],exclude:[],sources:[],destinations:[]},null,2)+'\n')" && rm -rf e2e-ui/sftp-data && docker compose -f e2e-ui/docker-compose.yml up -d --build app postgres sftp sqldb appvol && sleep 8 && docker compose -f e2e-ui/docker-compose.yml run --rm browser; EXIT=$?; docker compose -f e2e-ui/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans -v; exit $EXIT
